purpose: A braced expression in an HSPICE .meas card is refused; HSPICE delimits expressions with quotes.

oracle.derivation: Star-Hspice Manual, Release 1998.2, ch. 3 (class.ece.uw.edu/cadta/hspice/chapter_3.pdf) p. 3-19 and p. 3-21: expressions are delimited by single or double quotes; HSPICE Quick Reference Guide U-2003.03 (cse.chalmers.se/~perla/ugrad/EDA351/HSPICEQuickRef.pdf): an expression is written '...' as input and PAR('...') as output. at={1n} is neither a number nor an expression, so the card fails.
oracle.confirmed_reason: No second simulator reads the HSPICE dialect: Xyce -hspice-ext is Xyce's own extension, not HSPICE; the manuals are the oracle.
